## #520 evidence and source scope

Unfixed baseline distribution `6f89bc7cecee5972909828103689e2c7c0711c30`, ES
`4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. Actual pinned rclone1.75.1:

`f66d8c1d552ad90296a11bc8b46d56a7fa5da1a7fa05e7ca522d95df92c4a4c0`.

- PPSSPP writer uses ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA with ms0 at `/storage/roms/psp`, so
  normal files are `psp/PSP/SAVEDATA/<id>/<file>`, depth5. A directory getter
  alone led to a wrong initial path; full writer/mount/patch chain corrects it.
- DuckStation launcher redirects native cards to `psx/duckstation/memcards`,
  depth4; exact packaged source/binary confirms .mcd names. Preserve legacy
  psx/memcards rules and importable .mcr compatibility.
- Mupen64Plus configured native slot states are `n64/<name>.st[0-9]`, alternate
  .pj[0-9] and .pj[0-9].zip. This differs from .eep/.mpk/.sra/.fla already
  fixed under #89. Preserve valid locations and narrow slot/system patterns.
- The validator keeps base depth3,25seconds,4096 entries/2MiB per listing;
  the current fix supplements only observed standard PSP/Duck subtrees.
  Do not infer save presence from a directory name or scan an unbounded root.
- Save and content filters/classifiers must agree across backup, restore,
  list/count, scan and match/prune. Old content backups must not overwrite
  newer local progress. No historical cloud copy cleanup is included.
